title: AFOSI agent has crew sign non-disclosure agreement
summary: Robert Salas tells of AFOSI agent has crew sign non-disclosure agreement, about March 1967 at Squadron commander's office, Malmstrom Air Force Base, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Squadron commander's office, Malmstrom Air Force Base

tellings.quote: And by the way, he introduced me to a man from AFOSI, Air Force Office of Special Investigation.
